comsol.display: Nearest exported COMSOL value at each mesh vertex; linear interpolation across connected faces.

preview.method: Connected display mesh reduction, never triangle subsampling. All original files unchanged.
preview.ct_component: Largest connected exterior only for the preview; internal cavity surfaces remain in the original 3MFs.
preview.3mf_color_mapping: Area-weighted original face palettes at original vertices, then nearest-source-vertex transfer to display mesh.
preview.pbr_preview: Approximate lighting; per-face specular/gloss material extension is not reproduced exactly.

stress_3mf_values: Paper-image color reference only; no raw numerical stress values.

table9.scope: Saved recalibrated 18 µm L2 pressure experiment; full CT is a display projection, not a new solve.

reconstructed_models.display_note: Both browser levels are reduced displays. Original unmodified source is available for download.
reconstructed_models.color_note: Original source is uncolored. Natural/paper colors are reference projections, with prior z spacing corrected from 16 to 18 µm.

reconstructed_models.display_note: Both browser levels are reduced displays. Original unmodified source is available for download.
reconstructed_models.color_note: Original source is uncolored. Natural/paper colors are reference projections, with prior z spacing corrected from 16 to 18 µm.

full_ct_field_display.geometry: All source triangle indices; positions quantized only for browser transfer.
full_ct_field_display.projection: Nearest saved L2 element centroid in the same physical 18 µm scanner frame; no old 16/18 factor. Geometry is unchanged. Q_F values are fixed regional volume-weighted summaries.
full_ct_field_display.q_definition: The original frozen region labels and checked regional quantiles; unassigned regions are gray.
full_ct_field_display.field_case: Recalibrated 18 µm L2 pressure experiment of the nine-page paper

simplified_display: Exact previous-edition table9-visualizations.json geometry and values; full solver boundary, original Q regions and element centroids.
default_view: Archived COMSOL solver projected onto all original natural-colored CT triangles

natural_full_geometry.field: Archived COMSOL scalar values in Pa; nearest original sample at each original CT vertex. No numerical inference from color.
natural_full_geometry.colors: Original embedded area-weighted vertex colors from the natural/stress 3MF packages.

qf_full_geometry.geometry: All source triangle indices; positions quantized only for browser transfer.
qf_full_geometry.projection: Nearest saved L2 element centroid in the same physical 18 µm scanner frame; no old 16/18 factor. Geometry is unchanged. Q_F values are fixed regional volume-weighted summaries.
qf_full_geometry.q_definition: The original frozen region labels and checked regional quantiles; unassigned regions are gray.
qf_full_geometry.field_case: Recalibrated 18 µm L2 pressure experiment of the nine-page paper

archived_table9.status: self-checked against full raw field, frozen masks, CSV and revised paper Table 9
archived_table9.scope: New 1 MPa pressure experiment, not reproduction of the old withdrawn table.

archived_full_ct_field_display.geometry: All source triangle indices; positions quantized only for browser transfer.
archived_full_ct_field_display.projection: Nearest saved FE element centroid after registering the prior forced 16 µm z frame to the 18 µm CT frame. No new solve or quantile calculation.
archived_full_ct_field_display.q_definition: The original frozen region labels and checked regional quantiles; unassigned regions are gray.

natural_source_geometry_note: The original natural-colored 3MF is displayed unchanged in its archived geometry frame. It is distinct from the recalibrated 18 µm internal reconstruction.

loading_and_controls.chunk_integrity: SHA-256 verification, three bounded retry attempts, resumable source chunks
loading_and_controls.decode: Off-thread gzip and projection-color computation with pinned fallback for older Safari
loading_and_controls.projection_updates: Correct physical-frame case data; resize and device rotation recalculate viewport; WebGL restoration rebuilds buffers
